## Context

A quotation of the form, `ADR 0119`, is a mention of the syntax and not a use of the
reference, and so is `ADR-0134`.

A stray backtick ` in prose must not swallow the rest of this body.

ADR 0777 is a real bare reference and is still checked.

A closing span, `type: architecture`, deliberately carries no ordinal — an ordinal here
would be re-exposed by an unbounded span rather than lost, and the warning count would
not move.
